prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped at a traffic signal when the insured vehicle struck the rear of their car at a speed sufficient to cause significant impact. The police report documents the collision and identifies your insured as the driver who failed to stop in time, and the physical damage to our client's vehicle is consistent with that account.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a whiplash injury to the neck and upper back. Following the collision, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has since undergone a course of physical therapy and follow-up care. Our client continues to experience stiffness, headaches, and limited range of motion, and the treating physician has noted that recovery may be lengthy. Medical records and billing statements are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured owed a duty to maintain a safe following distance and to keep a proper lookout, and that duty was breached. Our client has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and considerable pain and suffering as a result.

We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims against your insured arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
